🍂 FARMSTAND MENU UPDATE 🍂

Well… this week definitely did not go according to plan! 😅

Between dealing with gallbladder issues that landed me in the ER for an entire day, accidentally cutting my hand with a butcher knife, and then having my glass bowl of proofing dough crash to the floor and shatter into what felt like a million pieces… I think the kitchen is telling me to slow down a little! ❤️‍🩹

Because I’m currently working with basically one good hand, I need to make a few changes to this week’s farmstand menu.

🫐 Unfortunately, there will NOT be Blueberry Cinnamon Rolls or Keto/Gluten-Free Blueberry Cinnamon Rolls this week.

But Blessed Harvest will still be OPEN with a limited menu of goodies I can safely prepare:

🍪 Chocolate Chip Cookies
🥨 NEW! Decorated Chocolate-Covered Pretzel Rods
🍎 Apple Pie Bars
🌶️🧀 NEW! Zucchini Cheddar Jalapeño Bread 

I’m disappointed that I can’t offer everything I had planned, but I’m thankful I can still put a few delicious things out at the farmstand for you this week.

Thank you so much for your patience, understanding, and continued support of Blessed Harvest Homestead. 💛

Sometimes you just have to roll with what the week gives you—and apparently this week gave me quite a lot! 😂

📅 Open Friday & Saturday
⏰ 9 AM–6 PM

Come see what I did manage to make with one good hand! 😂❤️
